decision_reason: GSA/FedRAMP and NIST evidence identifies this exact repository as an MVP tool for importing, editing, and exporting OSCAL SSP/SAP/SAR/POAM documents; the repo is public, has a GPL-3.0 license, and includes build/run instructions. But its README limits it to the obsolete OSCAL Milestone 3 schema, says it is standalone-only, directs checkout to a separate GSA/oscal-generator repository, and offers support only through the FedRAMP PMO. No versioned release or current exact-source support/distribution signal was found. Hold pending lineage to the successor and the first grant-bearing functional-source date.

decision_reason: The assigned GSA repository is a fork of geopython/OWSLib, the canonical Python client library for OGC web services. Its README identifies generic OGC client functionality and the root license credits the University of North Carolina's Ancient World Mapping Center; no GSA-authored modification, commissioning, use, or deployment is established. Reject this third-party fork as a GSA product lead.
